panels.title: Console logins (success vs failure)
panels.description: AWS Management Console sign-ins from CloudTrail. Failures spike on brute-force or credential-stuffing attempts.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AS t, if(error_message = '', 'success', 'failure') AS outcome, count() AS logins FROM siem.cloudtrail WHERE event_name = 'ConsoleLogin' AND $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY t, outcome ORDER BY t

panels.title: AccessDenied / Unauthorized trend
panels.description: Authorization failures across all CloudTrail management events. A rising trend means something (or someone) is probing.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AS t, count() AS denied FROM siem.cloudtrail WHERE error_code IN ('AccessDenied', 'UnauthorizedOperation', 'Client.UnauthorizedOperation', 'AccessDeniedException') AND $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

panels.title: Root account activity
panels.description: Any use of the AWS root principal. Expected: none. Investigate every row (CIS 1.7 / IA-2).

targets.rawSql: SELECT event_time, event_name, aws_region, source_ip, user_agent, error_code FROM siem.cloudtrail WHERE principal_type = 'Root' AND $__timeFilter(event_time) ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: IAM changes (writes only)
panels.description: Non-read-only calls to iam.amazonaws.com: user/role/policy create, delete, attach, key rotation. Review daily (AC-2).

targets.rawSql: SELECT event_time, event_name, principal_arn, source_ip, error_code FROM siem.cloudtrail WHERE event_source = 'iam.amazonaws.com' AND read_only = false AND $__timeFilter(event_time) ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 200
